items.content_html:
nordic was using the qt5 packages plasma-framework, plasma-workspace, and breeze-icons.
Plasma 5 and its packages (including plasma-workspace) are scheduled for removal until 25.11.
Depending on these qt5 packages is probelamtic and will break.

This is ignoring the fact it is also probably broken logic in the first place. If sddm needs packages to be themeable, those should then be part of the sddm module, if anything. Adding them to the theme package is silly.

items.content_html:
Added the SDDM theme, tokyo-night-sddm, which is based on sugar dark. Edited the name slightly to be more consistent with other SDDM theme packages.

First time contributor, so please tell me if I screwed something up! Made a new PR because the original didn't follow commit guidelines.

I found using some of the other SDDM theme packages frustrating, so I'm using propagatedUserEnvPkgs instead of propagatedBuildInputs or similar. That means you install the theme by:

services.displayManager.sddm = {
  enable = true;  
  theme = "tokyo-night";
};

environment.systemPackages = [ pkgs.sddm-tokyo-night];

Instead of having to add the package to both environment.systemPackages and services.displayManager.sddm.extraPackages.

items.content_html:
Motivation for this change

The SDDM display manager wants access to the .face.icon files stored in user home directories. Currently, this is not possible because systemd-tmpfiles resets the access permissions for home directories of users with createHome = true every reboot.

This PR simply gives SDDM the required access rights for all "normal" users.
